column1: # Every Roman emperor of the West, Augustus to Romulus Augustulus, as one beat
# each: a glyph for how they came in, a glyph for how they went out.
# The line stops at 476 deliberately. The Eastern line runs another thousand
# years and "every emperor" is a promise nobody keeps - see docs/EMPERORS.traj.
# The canon is the conventional one: the men usually counted, including the
# ones who held power for a fortnight, excluding the usurpers who never held
# Rome. Dates are reign years, AD unless marked BC, and rounded to the year.
# Where the ancient sources disagree about a death - and they disagree often,
# because a natural death and a quiet poisoning look identical at this
# distance - the fall glyph is ? rather than a guess dressed up as a fact.
# rise   > acclaimed by soldiers  ^ dynastic or adopted heir  $ bought it
#        x seized in civil war    + raised by the senate      = made colleague
# fall   ~ died of illness or age  ! murdered      # killed in battle
#        * executed or died a captive              % took his own life
#        v put down and outlived it                ? the sources disagree
